Hi Gaffer.
Just wanted to let you know that %1s is making excellent progress. It's great to see that you know a quality footballer when you see one.
Keep playing him, he still has lots to learn and I am sure he will keep making quick strides forward as long as he gets enough playing time.
Cheers,
Assistant Manager

\n\n<ManagerName2> has targeted one danger man in the middle from his upcoming opponents <TeamName1> and that is the <PlayerAge1> year old <FullPlayerName1> who is currently going through a purple patch that is winning him many accolades. <TeamName2> boss <ManagerName2> is obviously looking at shackling the <TeamName1> man.

{C:MICHAEL}{0.34-6.81}Palace. A team that’s trying to go places. Problem is, they were way too inconsistent last season.{7.61-13.04}For a young lad like you The Eagles could be a good fit and they’ll be looking for a top ten finish minimum.{13.75-16.68}Chances are you’d get lots of opportunities to get minutes on the pitch.

It's <TeamName5> who have progressed to this year's <CompetitionName> semi-final. In a tense quarter-final, that finished %1s-%2s, where the winners always looked to be by far the stronger of the two teams, they managed to win through %1s-%2s against a visibly distraught <TeamName6> who had done so well to make it this far.

"All the fans of <TeamName1> will be rooting for their troubled <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName1> who has managed a horrible %1s game goal drought. ""I'm going out there with a clear head and a lot of time in front of the net in practices"", stated the <Nationality> born player, ""I've got to get this monkey off my back."""

\n\n<UserName> will have to skip the celebration as the season is fast approaching and starting strong will be key to winning over skeptical <TeamName1> fans. World class teams like <TeamName1> come with world class expectations and only time will tell if he'll be the next great boss to leave his mark on <TeamName1> history.

Classic possession football. The team will move up the pitch when the opportunity presents itself, but keeping the ball will be of paramount importance. Players will opt to support more than going on forward runs.\nThis is a tactic used by teams who are comfortable on the ball, patient, and like to play a short passing game.

It's <TeamName5> who have triumphed in their latest match in this year's <CompetitionName>. In a tense match that finished %1s-%2s, where the winners always looked to be by far the stronger of the two teams, they managed to win through %1s-%2s against a visibly distraught <TeamName6> who had done so well to make it this far.

It was a bit early to call this a potential championship decider, but it was the top two going head to head and it was <TeamName5> who clawed back ground on the leaders by claiming the three points, against a disappointing <TeamName6> who must now wonder if they have the character to bounce back from this significant defeat.

"%2s's manager has praised %1s's passing ability the past few matches. ""Earlier in the season, %1s and I had  a discussion of what my expectations were and one of them was to control the midfield with good distribution which I can say he has been doing very well lately. I'm very content with his play,"" stated the manager."

Boss. I'll get straight to the point. I'm going to retire, it feels the right thing to do for myself and my family. I'll miss the daily banter with the lads and yourself, but I've made my mind up. If possible I'd love to be able to play a part in the final game, so I can say goodbye to the fans. I hope that will be possible.

"%2s's manager was quick to announce praise for %3s %1s for his recent displays in the past few matches. ""He seems to have a knack for being in on any goals we score,"" said the manager. The manager went on to state that he hopes the %2s %3s's performances will increase his confidence and bring him into a good run of form."

Midfielders have the burden of both containing the oppositions advances before reaching defenders and creating scoring opportunities for the men upfront. Having said this the deficiencies in the current <TeamName1> midfield are glaring and with the transfer window quickly approaching here are a few players that fit the bill.

Relegation was not what %1s fans would have been expecting at the start of the season, but now that they have secured their %2s spot, they want to put it all behind them. ''Next season needs to be different, hopefully the lads will now step up their game after experiencing a near relegation situation,'' explained %1s manager.

<TeamName> last night were mulling over a transfer request from <Nationality> <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName> as a number of clubs were rumoured to be lining up bids. <TeamName> are acutely aware that keeping the player will not do any good for the team's morale, but will be determined not to allow him to leave on the cheap.

"Initial reports claim that %1s are keen to sign %2s. The %3s %6s is also allegedly being tracked by a number of other teams. %1s hope to strengthen their squad by landing the %5s-year old from %7s. The %1s boss was not very forthcoming to the press about his interest, just saying that %4s was amongst the club's ""targets."""

The country is a strange place to me, boss. I hope you can see why I might be unsettled. I'm just not sure I will ever be able to feel at home here. If it's not the weather, it's the food. The whole place is doing my head in and I just wanted to talk it through with you so we might be able to come to some kind of arrangement.

In what could be a significant result, the league leaders were held to a draw by <TeamName4> as they missed out on a chance to stretch their lead at the top of the table. <TeamName4> were good value for their point, as they prevented <TeamName3> from playing the brand of football that has taken them to the summit this season.

{C:SUSAN WELLES}{1.03-5.12}I'm sure none of you need reminding about your league position. {6.19-9.60}Relegation is now a very real possibility. {10.38-15.34}I can hardly believe our predicament given where we were just a few months ago. {16.11-22.08}This may not be the biggest club in the world, but we belong in this league.

With the opportunity of first team football at <TeamName1> limited for <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName1>, the <PlayerAge> year old <PreferredPos1> has requested a loan move. <ManagerName1>, never one to stand in a players way, accepted the players request stating he'd do his utmost to try and help him get the move he desired.

In FUT 17 you’ll be able to try out some of the most highly sought after Players in the game right away by signing them to your Club on loan! \n Sign Loan Players for a set amount of matches and use them wisely during their Loan Contract’s duration to win a big Tournament Final or get the decisive win to clinch a Season Title.

{0.23-7.02}{C:KAREN}Alex Hunter has surprised a lot of people this season. A word on his, seemingly sudden, success.{7.11-18.25}{F}{C:ANGEL DI MARIA}Well, I think Alex… I think he has an incredible future.\nHe's working really hard, little by little he'll continue to improve. He's young, so I think he has an incredible future.

Talking to the press in the week, <FullPlayerName> had said he wasn't overly concerned with his performances in the warm up games, it was when the season started for real that really counted. He was true to his word, as he was one of the best performers on the park in the first match of the season, to prove his doubters wrong.

{C:ALEX}{1.12-7.65}Doesn't really matter now does it? My problems are my problems. I just need to perform on the pitch.{C:BUTLER}{8.04-11.73}If that's the way you want to look at it that's fine. {11.73-15.99}Just remember: You performing is what counts. So you better start soon, all right?{C:ALEX}{17.11-19.10}Yeah, Mr. Butler.

{C:ALEX}{0.11-4.02}Been that way since I was ten, Mr. Butler. Just comes natural.{C:BUTLER}{4.08-9.00}You're a good player, Hunter. Just be sure you have the skill to back up that chat, yeah?{C:ALEX}{9.10-12.00}Well, I think my play on the pitch does my talking for me.{C:BUTLER}{13.49-15.99}Time will tell, lad. Time will tell.

Much of the speculation before the game was whether <ManagerName> would keep faith with <FullPlayerName> given he had hardly set the world alight in pre-season. The <TeamName> boss decided to give his <PreferredPos1> another chance to find his form, and he was rewarded with an excellent display from the man from <Nationality>.

"<UserName> will be pleased today after his <TeamName1> side beat <TeamName2> in only his second match in charge of the team. <UserName> was clearly happy and it shone through in his post match interview ""The boys did themselves proud today. The performance wasn't perfect but we're definitely moving in the right direction."""

"<ManagerName> took a big risk on the fitness of <FullPlayerName> and it backfired as his <PreferredPos1> suffered a recurrence of the injury that kept him out in the first place. ""Yeah, on reflection I might not have done that, but it's too late now, he wanted to play, we thought it was a risk worth taking."" said the boss."

\n\n<PlayerName1> can feel justifiably aggrieved that he faces the chop in order to accommodate the manager's new signing <PlayerName2>. Recent performances have seen <PlayerName1> go from strength to strength but in spite of this it looks certain that his future involvement at <TeamName1> will be looking on from the sidelines.

I'm sorry about the stories that appeared in the press. I made some throwaway line about how cold and wet it was here compared to where I was born and raised and my words were twisted. I feel like such a fool. I hope you'll forgive me and let me prove myself in the team. I really didn't want to leave at this stage of my career.

"Despite some match winning performances in pre-season, <FullPlayerName> was left out of the team for the season opener. ""Yes it was disappointing not to get a chance, as I thought I'd done well in the warm up games"", he said. ""But I'll keep my head down, work hard in training, and hope to be given a chance at some stage."""

"The loss of a player usually causes most teams to experience the butterfly effect, but <TeamName1> have managed to pull off an impressive set of results. ""Determination, commitment and belief have been fundamental in our progress. I can't describe how proud I am of the team"" were the words of a very emotional <ManagerName1>."

{C:GEORGE}{2.97-3.85}Hunter. {6.16-10.75}Listen, I know you fancy yourself as a bit of a multi-dimensional player that can play anywhere, {11.30-14.38}but today you get to choose which position's best for you. {14.85-18.60}So put your best foot forward. Impress these scouts, all right, lad? {18.89-20.98}So what's it going to be?

On the Squad screen, select a player and bring up the Actions menu. Choose Swap Player, then use the filters to find the type of player you want to swap into your squad from your Club. \nAdditionally, you can also bring a player from your club into your squad by highlighting an empty position and selecting the Add Player option.

\n\nIt's early days yet in the <TeamName1> career of <UserName>, but this victory can only prove to his critics that he has the tools to get the most out of the players at his disposal. The upcoming games will give him a better chance to assess his squads strengths and weaknesses which may see him delve into the transfer market.

I've given it my best shot, boss, but I just don't like it here and I want to leave. I know you'll be annoyed but that can't be helped. I want to go somewhere I feel more suited to. I hope you won't stand in my way. I've spoken to my agent and he says it might take a while. I'm still committed to you and the team while I'm here.

<FullPlayerName> is a finally a <TeamName> player after inking a %1s year contract that sees the <PreferredPos1> move from <TeamName2> in a transfer deal worth a reported <Currency>.\n<PlayerName> had been widely expected to move after publicly doubting his ability to adjust to weather conditions far colder than he was used to.

To nobody's surprise, it's <TeamName5> who have progressed to this year's <CompetitionName> final. In a semi-final, that finished %1s-%2s, where the winners always looked to be a class above their opponents, they managed to win through %1s-%2s against a brave <TeamName6> who have had an amazing run in the tournament this season.

\n\nIt's been a testing few weeks for the <TeamName1> board as a number of clubs have attempted to prise their talismanic manager away without any success. The latest bid to lure <ManagerName1> away could be seen as the biggest test yet for a board who are eager to carry on with the success brought during <ManagerName1>'s reign.

{C:KAREN WALSTON}{0.19-6.72}Alex, a dream debut for you. I bet you couldn't have imagined you'd be stood here talking with us today. {7.04-13.54}A couple of months ago you were on the fringes of the squad. Then a couple of injuries and suddenly you're on the first team. {14.26-17.16}How does it feel to have scored on your debut?

The team has had to adjust to the chopping and changing line up since the departure of <PlayerName2>. With his experience and talent gone we have struggled to rebalance the team. But we're hopeful that <PlayerName1> can adjust to the <PreferredPos1> role given more time was the statement of a clearly worried <TeamName1> manager.

Already crowned Champions <TeamName1> may have their league season already determined but <TeamName2> will be hoping <TeamName1> will not be playing in top gear so they can get a extra points on the board. The <TeamName1> fans have a lot to sing about but fans of <TeamName2> will hope to spoil the party at least for a short time.

"\n\nAfter a string of friendly games under the manager's belt, <UserName> will be looking forward clinching his first competitive win. ""This is the real test for the players. As long as they don't become arrogant and stay focused we will succeed. There is no room for error as we will be punished"" declared <TeamName>'s manager."

{C:CATHERINE}{0.92-2.71}Oh come on, tell him!{C:ALEX}{2.77-3.50}Tell me what?{C:MICHAEL}{4.00-10.06}As soon as you signed with me I started putting out the feelers. The Board held a meeting last night, and the unanimous decision was that <FullPlayerName> cannot be allowed to continue at this football club and drag our name through the media on a daily basis.\r\nWe are instructing you as our employee to sell this disruptive influence and secure a decent price for him.\r\nThe Board of Directors.

The buzz around the ground before kick off, was the difference that returning <FullPlayerName> would make to the team. But as the <TeamName> fans traipsed off home at the end of proceedings, they were looking back on a less than impressive performance from <PlayerName> who would have hoped for far better on his long awaited return.

{C:MICHAEL}{0.33-3.30}Back in the Premier League for the first time in seven years.{4.04-7.52}Boro fans have been looking for a new hero to take the club to the next level.{8.10-15.01}With plenty of match time likely if you signed for them you’d have every chance to impress the faithful and become the hero the fans are looking for.

"\n\nBack to back wins were out of reach for <TeamName> after their second match defeat but manager <UserName> is determined not to have back to back losses on his team record. ""Another defeat would not be an option. There is no reason why we should not win the next game the players have no excuse and the crowd will be behind us"""

This mid season encounter has the extra incentive for the two teams of getting one over their rivals. <TeamName1> welcome <TeamName2> for this league game, with their fans being desperate to obtain the bragging rights. <TeamName3> have the upper hand in the league this season, but that often counts for little in these type of games.

"<ManagerName> has deflected attention away from himself ahead of the upcoming game against <TeamName2>, preferring instead to give credit to the players.\nHe said: ""It's really not about me, it's about them. They have a fantastic work ethic and a strong group identity and that makes managing <TeamName> a pleasure at the moment."""

Manager <UserName> readies his national side for the encounter against <TeamName2>. <UserName> wants to instil <TeamName> with the same mentality to play football that he's successfully employed at his club side onto the international stage. It's this style that he hopes will achieve victory in only his third game as national coach.

Regardless of <TeamName1>'s performances many fans will begin to believe that the strength in the <TeamName1> attack is lacking that certain cutting edge. While fans would want make their opinion heard and acted upon it is up to <ManagerName1> to build his team and unfortunately some of his decisions could go against public opinion.

Dear Mr. %1s,
If you don't perform well, your reputation as a manager will suffer. 
Unfortunately, this is exactly what has happened. We really hope you can get your act together and turn the ship around.
If not, we might have to show you the door before the end of the season.
Yours sincerely,
The %2s Board of Directors

The sun shone right on cue today as <FullPlayerName> inked a %1s year contract to join <TeamName> after failing to cope with the weather at <TeamName2>. The deal, worth a reported <Currency> sees an end to the saga begun after <PlayerName> let it be known that he wanted to play in a climate more similar to the one he had grown up in.

\n\nAlthough eager to enter the transfer market <UserName> is determined to make sure everyone in the squad gets a fair crack of the whip before any movement in or out of the club. The players know they are fighting for a place in the team and if they don't come up to scratch <UserName> will have no qualms about getting new faces in.

I wanted to explain to you that I'm not entirely happy here at the moment and feeling a bit homesick. I like the lads, and everything, and everyone here has tried really hard to make me feel welcome, but I'm just not sure it's working out for me. I respect you as a manager and I wanted to make sure you knew exactly how I was feeling.

\n\nSpeculation over the future of <ManagerName1> has been rife over recent weeks. Considering the earlier offer from <TeamName2> the <TeamName1> boss might now have a bit of a testing dilemma to solve. How would he divide his time between his club management and his international duties? The ball is firmly in <ManagerName1>'s court.

"Fans haven't been overly impressed with their new signing since forking out <Currency1> recently. When asked about his performances <PlayerName1> simply replied ""I don't want to let anyone down. The club and manager are behind me one hundred percent. If they weren't I wouldn't be here. It's just going to take a little more time."""

Incredibly it's <TeamName5> who have won through to this year's <CompetitionName> final. In a tense semi-final, where the winners looked to have no hope at all, they somehow managed to produce another amazing performance to win through %1s-%2s against overwhelming favourites <TeamName6> who were certain that this would be their year.

\n\nWith two victories already under his belt, manager <UserName>, will be looking to add to this good run against <TeamName2>. If <UserName> can gain another victory then the Football Association of <TeamName> will strongly believe they have made a terrific appointment and this series of results will only add merit to their decision.

{C:ALEX}{0.13-4.76}It's a bit of a cliché, I know, but on any given day any team can beat any other team in this league. {5.40-9.43}Uh, you know we lost a few key players, but we've got a talented squad. {9.50-14.97}The gaffer's got the tactics and the side spot on, and we've come away with a win that I think we can be very happy with.

Another win will surely give early indication that, under his leadership, he can build a team into a winning unit. However another loss may well rock the team's confidence at this early rebuilding stage.

Now at the ripe age of <PlayerAge>, suggestions that <FullPlayerName> is in his final season are rife.  No official word yet from the player or his agent but the player is known to have a variety of interests away from the game and he feels that he has had a long career and now might be the time to move on to the next phase of his life.

Today we are instructing you to sell <FullPlayerName> due to the negative impact he is having at this club.
We are fed up of reading constant speculation about this player in the press.
His time to decide to commit his future to the club has passed, and he is a bad apple who must be removed.

\n\nThis latest attempt to lure the <TeamName1> manager away comes hot on the heels of a number of recent enquiries about the enigmatic boss.
